name: Boku-tachi no Sei Kurabe
source:
Kenta-kun, Yuu-kun and Sara-chan have a fun bath at sensei's house. 
Kenta-kun and friends meet a catlike older girl. They bring her home to play lots and lots. 
A nice man who promises to buy gifts wants to make a special video.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE134896.html]DLsite English[/url]]
